text:
I honestly don't know how so many of you, like the VPs, officers and Gen Comm and tech leads (as well as everyone else), have all put in so many hours to keep this society running. Somehow, you've all made every event shine even more than in previous years, and that's something everyone should be incredibly proud of!!
And truly, Jzk for all your efforts. May Allah grant all of us careers that strengthen the Ummah and allow us to show what it means to be Muslim not just in what we say but most importantly through our actions, the intentions of our actions as well as our characters.

This society has genuinely been one of the best parts of my university experience. The amount of care and thought that goes into every event is so obvious, and it's made me feel so welcomed from day one. Jzk to every single person who made this year what it was.

Coming into uni I had no idea what to expect, but STEMM gave me a community I didn't even know I needed. The events, the people, the atmosphere — it's all been incredible. May Allah bless this whole team and everyone who's been a part of it.

To everyone who stayed up late planning events, designing things, dealing with logistics and still showed up with a smile — you are genuinely appreciated more than you know. This year has been special and it's entirely because of the people in this society.

The standard this year has been unreal. Every single event felt like it had so much love poured into it. Jzk to the whole committee and everyone who contributed — you've set a bar that's going to be very hard to match!

I joined STEMM not really knowing anyone and honestly it's changed my whole uni experience. The warmth and effort of the people here is something I'll always be grateful for. Make sure you all take a moment to appreciate what you've built.
Genuinely cannot believe how much this society has grown and improved. It's a testament to how hard everyone has worked behind the scenes. May Allah put barakah in all your efforts — it really shows.

What strikes me most about STEMM is how everyone genuinely looks out for each other. It never feels transactional — people are here because they care. That's rare and it's something to be really proud of as a community.

Jzk to the committee for making this year so memorable. The events were amazing but more than that, the sense of community you've built is something that'll stick with all of us long after we graduate.

I've been to a lot of society events over my time at uni and I can say with confidence that STEMM has consistently been the most thoughtfully run society I've encountered. Everyone involved should be extremely proud.

The effort that goes into making every member feel seen and included doesn't go unnoticed. From the socials to the bigger events — it all feels intentional. Jzk to everyone for making STEMM feel like home.

This is probably going to be one of those things I look back on and realise just how special it was. Being part of this community at this time has been a real blessing. May Allah reward the whole team.

I think the thing that stands out most is how the committee genuinely care about the members and not just the numbers. You can feel it in the way events are run and the way people are treated. That's not something you find everywhere.

Couldn't have asked for a better group of people to be around during uni. STEMM has been a constant source of positivity and motivation for me. Massive Jzk to everyone who's put their time and energy into making this what it is.

May Allah reward every single person who gave their time to this society this year. What you've built has touched more people than you probably realise. The community, the connections, the memories — all of it has been truly special.

Every time I come to a STEMM event I leave feeling more motivated and more connected. It's a really hard thing to create that kind of atmosphere consistently and you've all managed it this whole year. Huge Jzk.

Looking back at this year I'm so grateful I got involved with STEMM. The friendships, the experiences, the reminders of what we're all working towards — it's been invaluable. Thank you to everyone who made it happen.

The level of dedication I've seen from the people running this society is honestly inspiring. You've managed to build something that genuinely reflects good values and good character. May Allah make it a sadaqah jariyah for everyone involved.

STEMM has been a place where I've felt able to grow not just academically but as a person. The reminders, the conversations, the events — all of it has added something real to my time at uni. Jzk to everyone.

I just want to say how much I've appreciated being part of this community. The hard work of the committee never goes unnoticed, and the results speak for themselves. This year has been one to remember.
Truly one of the best decisions I made at uni was getting involved with STEMM. The people here are so genuine and the environment that's been created is something really special. Jzk to all of you.

The amount of behind the scenes work that goes into everything STEMM does is something most people don't see, but those of us who've been involved know just how much effort it takes. May Allah reward everyone abundantly.

I think what makes STEMM different is that it never loses sight of the bigger picture — yes the events are great, but it's always rooted in something more meaningful. That's down to the people who lead it and everyone who's been a part of it.

This year has flown by and I think that's partly because every week there's been something worth showing up for. Jzk to the whole committee for keeping the energy going all year — it really has made a difference.

Just want to put on record how much this society has meant to me. The friends I've made, the things I've learned, the moments I'll remember — a lot of that is because of STEMM. Massive Jzk to everyone involved, may Allah bless you all.
